scope: First five partial scalar/object contracts. Types/units are upstream declarations in the stated scope, not implicit runtime coercion or global physical validity. Remaining registry entries stay unreviewed.

records.scope: Raw scalar API documentation and explicitly named workflow/control subsets; this does not add runtime validation or grant full numerical acceptance.

domain.rawBranches: d1=Thi-Tco,d2=Tho-Tci for counter-current; otherwise d1=Thi-Tci,d2=Tho-Tco. ratio=d2/d1. For ratio<=0 or ratio==1: counter-current returns d1, co-current returns 0. Otherwise logarithmic mean. d1=0 raises division by zero before the branch.
